title: Heartbeat
subtitle: Periodically feeds the HEARTBEAT.md checklist to the agent; results land in a dedicated session
enableHelp: When enabled, the checklist is sent to the agent automatically at the configured interval
intervalHelp: e.g. 30m, 1h, 2h30m, 90s; cron expressions are not supported yet
activeHoursHelp: Runs only inside this window; leave empty to run around the clock
activeHoursIncomplete: Active hours require both a start and an end time
queryFilePresent: HEARTBEAT.md exists — edit it on the Files page to change the checklist
queryFileMissing: HEARTBEAT.md is missing — heartbeat runs are skipped while the file is absent
